title: ZBlock 2mL Starter Kit - Trippin Triple Berry
description:
The
ZBlock 2mL Starter Kit - Trippin Triple Berry
is an entry point to the ZBlock closed pod system by ZiipLab. The kit pairs the draw-activated ZBlock device with prefilled 2mL pods at 20mg/mL salt nicotine  -  no refilling, no coils and no settings.
Product Type:
Starter Kit (closed pod system)
E-Liquid Capacity:
2mL per pod
Nicotine Strength:
20mg/mL (2%) salt nicotine
Flavour Profile:
Triple Berry
Activation:
Draw-activated (no buttons)
Compatible Devices:
ZBlock 2mL prefilled pods
Pack Contents:
1 x ZBlock Battery Device, 1 x prefilled 2mL pod
Brand:
ZBlock
This product contains nicotine. Nicotine is a highly addictive substance.
